issues: Meaning drift: "Penyelenggaraan" is better rendered as "Administration/Implementation" but the standard legal title is "Administration"; current "Implementation" is acceptable but "with the grace of God Almighty" should be attached to the enacting authority clause, not the subject title.

Meaning drift: missing translation of "Dengan Rahmat Tuhan Yang Maha Esa" as a standalone phrase/clause; it is incorrectly merged into the subject line. It should appear as its own line after the subject heading or as part of the preamble, not appended to the title.
Meaning drift/typo in legal citation: item 4 incorrectly states "State Gazette ... Year 1945"; the original refers to the State Gazette of 1974 (Marriage Law).
Meaning drift/omission in item 13: the original includes the Indonesian title in parentheses (Konvensi Mengenai Hak-Hak Penyandang Disabilita), which is missing in the translation.
Meaning drift: item 18 adds "normally" ("secara wajar") should modify "social interaction" as "reasonably/appropriately", not add a general adverb; adjust to reflect "secara wajar" more faithfully.

Minor meaning drift/wording: item 20 term order is unnatural and can imply a category rather than the defined term; should be "Female Domestic Worker" / "Women Domestic Workers" corresponding to "Perempuan Pekerja Rumah Tangga".
Scrambled list structure: items b and c are merged on one line; items g and h are merged on one line; list markers should be separated and ordered as in the original.
List structure issue: items a and b are run together on one line; should be separated as distinct lettered points.
Meaning drift: "kelangsungan hidupnya" refers to the continuity/sustainability of their lives, not "their survival" in the sense of mere survival.
Scrambled list/numbering structure: items b–d are run together on one line instead of separated as distinct list items.
Scrambled/merged list structure: items b–e are run together and item b is incomplete; list markers and content need to be separated and reassociated per the original.

Meaning drift/unnatural rendering in item (2)(e): "saksi dan korban" translated as "witnesses and victims"; in context it refers to protection for female workers/laborers who are witnesses and/or victims (witness/victim protection).
List structure is scrambled: items a–d are run together on the same lines instead of clearly separated, which can affect downstream parsing.

Meaning drift: "Perempuan Pekerja Rumah Tangga" refers to women who are domestic workers (female domestic workers), not "Female Domestic Workers" as a standalone category; translation should reflect "Women Domestic Workers"/"Women Household Workers" consistent with the Indonesian phrasing.

Meaning drift/awkward rendering in paragraph (1): "recovery from trauma and health" should reflect "pemulihan trauma dan kesehatan" (recovery of trauma and health/health recovery), not recovery from health.
Minor meaning drift in item d: "relayanan" indicates (re-)services for trauma and health; translation omits the re-/renewal nuance.
Scrambled list structure: items a and b are merged on one line; should be separated into distinct list items matching the original.
Scrambled list structure: several lettered items (a/b) are run together on the same line instead of being clearly separated as distinct list items (in paragraphs (1) and (6)).

Scrambled list structure in Article 28(2): item a ends with 'regarding;' and item b contains the object; in the original, item a should include 'policies on women's empowerment and protection' as one complete item.

Meaning drift: "Diundangkan" should be rendered as "Enacted" (or "Promulgated"), but "Pada tanggal" should be "on" and the title "Pj." should be kept as acting/interim; current translation leaves "Pj." unexplained and uses unnatural capitalization/phrasing.
Untranslated Indonesian notation left in place: "Cap/dto" should be translated (stamp/signature notation).
Meaning drift: "PEMBINA TK I" is a civil-service rank (Pembina Tingkat I), not "Supervisor Level I"
